title: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no ad

translated_title: PIPETTE：面向鲁棒LLM智能体的提示注入紫队测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体经常与不可信的外部数据交互，使其暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）攻击之下，此类攻击会劫持智能体去执行攻击者选定的任务。为了大规模地揭示这些漏洞，自动化红队测试方法通常借助强化学习（RL）来生成具有高攻击成功率（ASR）的攻击。模型开发者利用内部红队测试中发现的攻击，在部署前通过对抗训练来强化智能体，这种攻防协作的过程在网络安全领域被称为紫队测试。然而，我们证明红队测试阶段达到高攻击成功率并不能保证后续对抗训练带来鲁棒性提升。具体而言，我们发现两种最先进的基于强化学习的红队测试方法RL-Hammer和PISmith存在模式坍塌问题，即反复发现相似的攻击策略，其额外取得的攻击成功不再带来新的收益（原摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 论文揭示了基于强化学习的红队方法因模式坍塌而反复生成相似攻击，导致红队测试中的高攻击成功率无法转化为对抗训练后智能体的真实鲁棒性提升。
en_tdlr: High attack success rates in RL-based red-teaming do not guarantee robustness gains from adversarial training, as state-of-the-art methods like RL-Hammer and PISmith suffer from mode collapse when discovering attack strategies.
